name: External Post Trade Event Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of post trade event, as published in an external post trade event type code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

PEAM.name: Partial Early Delivery
PEAM.definition: Trade will be partially settled early.

PRUR.name: Partial Unwind Rollover
PRUR.definition: Part of the trade will be settled on its original date and the remainder will rollover.

PRUW.name: Partial Unwind
PRUW.definition: Part of the trade will not be settled.

UNWR.name: Unwind Rollover
UNWR.definition: Original trade will not settle on its original date, but will be rolled over.
